static_traits.name: Li Ming
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with friends strained by persistent self-criticism; Has one supportive friend but has not yet fully opened up about hiking-related Self-doubt
static_traits.medical_history: Has not yet received psychotherapy; no significant physical illness; has not previously experienced similar hiking-related problems
static_traits.language_features: Somewhat Anxious at the first visit; clear expression, Good logic; capable of self-Reflection; highly cooperative, Positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: I have a strong passion for hiking, but I constantly doubt my hiking ability and label myself a 'bad hiker'. These not-good-enough feelings began a few years ago with a struggle on a high-difficulty hiking route. The initial stress was moderate, with the trigger coming from comparing myself with experienced hikers. Over time, Self-doubt worsens when planning hikes with friends. These negative thoughts appear both before and during hikes, making the experience less pleasant. I tried challenging these thoughts by seeking others' approval, but have not yet felt better.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize that negative self-labels are affecting my hiking experience and overall enjoyment, so I seek counseling to change this situation.
growth_experiences: Struggled on a high-difficulty hiking route a few years ago, after which the experience was taken as evidence that one is 'not a good hiker', gradually forming stable Self-doubt and negative self-labels.

On a hike last month, worried from before departure about being unable to keep up with friends' pace; when reaching a steep slope, Self-doubt escalated, worrying about slowing teammates and taking that stretch as further confirmation of 'I am a poor hiker', markedly reducing that hike's enjoyment.

core_beliefs: My hiking is not as good as those more experienced peers

special_situations.event: A few years ago, showed obvious struggle on a difficult hiking route
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I struggle on difficult sections, it shows I am not a good hiker
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeking friends' approval and evaluation to ease Self-doubt
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: That struggle proves I am not good at hiking

special_situations.event: When planning a hike with more experienced friends, makes comparisons
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot keep up with friends' pace, I will drag everyone down and prove I am not capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly comparing and worrying before departure, resting more frequently and Self-monitoring during hikes

special_situations.event: During hiking, encounters steep slopes or more challenging sections
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I perform poorly on difficult sections, it proves I am a 'bad' hiker
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Grits teeth and pushes through but continuously makes negative self-evaluations, hard to enjoy the process
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is evidence that I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Friends giving positive feedback (saying I did well)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Unless I keep receiving others' affirmation, my ability does not stand
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuously seeking others' approval, but not accepting positive feedback
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just comforting me; actually I am not capable

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized in the group and accepted as a reliable companion
core_conflict.fear: Fear of dragging others down, being judged as not good enough or incompetent
defense_goal: Avoiding others' negation through self-criticism and careful performance monitoring
Easing Anxiety and maintaining a sense of security by seeking external approval

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough fellow traveler who may drag others down
object_relations.object_representation: More experienced others / friends who are highly judgmental and have strict standards

manifestations: Relationships with friends strained by Persistent self-criticism
Finding it hard to fully open up about hiking-related Self-doubt to supportive friends

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessive Self-doubt and comparison before hiking
Frequent self-evaluation and self-criticism during hiking
Worries about slowing down teammates, focuses excessively on one's own performance, reducing enjoyment

positive_force: Has completed multiple hikes (including harder routes), with a certain amount of competence evidence
Willing to seek counseling and try cognitive restructuring, with self-Reflection ability
negative_force: Tendency toward excessive comparison and personalization
Negating positive feedback, relying on external approval but struggling to internalize it
Stable negative self-labels and Self-doubt damaging the experience

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Self-doubt and negative self-labels in hiking-related situations (e.g. 'I am a terrible hiker'), accompanied by Anxiety and avoiding enjoying the moment
antecedent: Planning a hike with more experienced friends
Anticipation and comparison before hiking begins
Encountering steep slopes or difficult sections during the hike
Recalls struggling on difficult routes a few years ago
target_behavior.core_reason: The struggle on a high-difficulty route years ago overgeneralized as stable evidence of incompetence; comparison with others and worry about dragging others down intensifying personalization and catastrophizing; dependence on external approval making it impossible to internalize positive information
target_behavior.function: Avoiding feelings of being judged and failing; temporarily easing uncertainty through Self-monitoring and seeking others' approval
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased hiking enjoyment, Tense relationships with friends, confidence in other life areas affected (Work not yet directly impaired)
